name: Circle Head
source:
You think it's hell. But it's only when your A/C breaks and you call a technician, that you find out true hell is shown in the form of a circle. . . . and he wants to put a ring on it.   

[From [url=https://g0rg3h.itch.io/circlehead]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你以为那是地狱。但只有当你的空调坏了并且你打电话给技术人员时，你才会发现真正的地狱是以圆圈的形式显示的。。。。他想给它戴上戒指。

[来自[url=https://g0rg3h.itch.io/circlehead]itch.io[/url]]
